summary.text: Karla Rose Hanson is a Democratic member of the North Dakota House of Representatives, representing District 44 (home city listed as Fargo), serving since 2017 per the legislature's member page.

paragraphs.text: The legislature's biography for Hanson lists an occupation of Small Business Owner.
It lists education as BA, NDSU.
It also lists Board, Crime Victims Services, Lottery Commission and Juvenile Justice Commission.
Family is listed as: Married (Shawn); 2 children.
For the 2025 regular session, the page lists Hanson's standing committee assignments as Appropriations and Appropriations - Education and Environment Division.
